business_scope.primary_industry_name: Vessel Hull and Cargo Damage Marine Claims Inspection Survey

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: UK-Bermuda Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA), signed 2002, in force 2007
No separate Bermuda-centric bilateral investment treaty is in force; UK BITs apply to Bermuda only where express territorial extension exists
Bermuda is a participating jurisdiction in the OECD Common Reporting Standard and the FATF international co-operation framework

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Companies Act 1981 (Exempted Companies); Proceeds of Crime Act 1997; Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2018; Beneficial Ownership (Companies) Act 2017; Beneficial Ownership (Companies) Regulations 2018; Anti-Terrorism (Financial and Other Measures) Act 2004; Sanctions Act 2020; Bermuda Monetary Authority AML/ATF Code of Conduct 2008.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport for each proposed director, shareholder, UBO, and authorised representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority plus notary public or certified professional in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for Apostille Convention countries) OR Consular Legalization (for non-Convention countries)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for directors, shareholders, UBOs, and source-of-funds validation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing financial institution, with signature notarised and authenticated

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency for any corporate beneficial owner or corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or company secretary in the jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential or business address for directors and UBOs (utility bill or government-issued electoral record)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or government-issued register in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarised copy; Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization where required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed shareholders, directors, UBOs, authorised representatives, and high-risk related parties against the UN Consolidated List, UK HM Treasury Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, and the Bermuda Sanctions List. PEPs are classified as higher-risk; source of wealth and source of funds evidence must be validated, enhanced monitoring must be applied, and senior management approval is required. Adverse media, negative news, and FATF-relevant checks are mandatory under the BMA AML/ATF Code of Conduct 2008.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Business Registries – Companies e-Services Portal (Registry General, Ministry of Finance, Hamilton)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All company names must be submitted in Roman/Latin characters using English spelling; no concurrent foreign-language name appears on the certificate of incorporation. The statutory name is exactly as filed and must be readily distinguishable from existing and reserved names. Names in non-Latin script or names requiring transliteration are not accepted for the registered legal name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Where a proposed name is refused, the applicant may file a written administrative reconsideration request with the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the refusal notice, setting out grounds and evidence of any required BMA or ministerial consent for sensitive tokens. If the refusal is upheld, the applicant may seek judicial review in the Supreme Court of Bermuda within 21 days. Reserved names are not automatically extended; a request for extension must be made before expiry with statutory justification.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the sole registered office. A Bermuda exempted company must maintain a physical registered office in Bermuda at a street address that is open and staffed during normal business hours. A virtual office may be used only for supplementary mail forwarding or administrative convenience and cannot satisfy the statutory registered-office requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for a non-custodial marine insurance surveying entity: approximately 5–10% probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection in the first three years. The risk increases to approximately 15–25% if the company handles client funds, acts as a regulated insurance intermediary, or otherwise falls within the BMA's AML on-site inspection cycle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: BMA statutory registration/licence for marine insurance claims surveying activity
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: BMA application and registration fee under the relevant Bermuda insurance regulatory provisions and prevailing market benchmark for claims surveyor authorisation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office retainer for first year of operation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed corporate services provider in Bermuda
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for physical registered-office service to exempted companies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO/AML/KYC initial due diligence, PEP and sanctions screening, and entity file maintenance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Local registered agent or corporate services provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional fee benchmark required under the BMA AML/ATF Code of Conduct 2008 and Proceeds of Crime Regulations 2018

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarisation, apostille, or consular legalisation of passport, bank reference, good standing, and proof-of-address documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notary, apostille, consular, and courier fees for international document certification

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate secretarial and pre-incorporation filing support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed corporate services provider in Bermuda
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed fee for company formation, registered agent, and statutory filings

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 1981 (Bermuda), Part II (ss. 4-12) — incorporation and registration; s. 14 — exempted company status; ss. 25-27 — share capital; s. 36 — registered office. Subordinate: Companies (Registration Fees) Regulations 1982; Business Licences Act 1990 and Business Licences Regulations 1991.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Registry, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda (Hamilton, Bermuda).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and Bye-laws filed together with the Application for Registration of an Exempted Company, culminating in the issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a Bermuda exempted company; at least one issued share per subscriber is required. Shares may be denominated in any currency at par, and no escrow, capital duty, or security deposit account is mandated under Bermuda law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription of one common voting share of par value BD$0.01 issued to the founding subscriber, in consideration of cash fully paid to the Company, be and is hereby approved and ratified. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be established and maintained at the office of the Company's licensed registered agent in Hamilton, Bermuda, and that said licensed agent be appointed to act as registered agent. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Chairperson] be appointed Chief Executive Officer/President and [Secretary] be appointed Secretary/Treasurer, each to hold office until the next Annual General Meeting. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the officers are authorised to file all statutory returns, complete the Business Licence application, open bank and Wise accounts, and execute all ancillary instruments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Name Section, Companies Registry, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda (filed electronically by the licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed exempted company names for availability screening, pay the reservation fee, and obtain a name reservation letter valid for 30 days. The name must end in 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' and must not contain prohibited words such as 'Trust', 'Assurance', 'Bank', or 'Insurance' except with the relevant supervisory authority's consent.
required_dossiers: Bermuda name availability search requisition form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a proposed name is refused due to similarity, obscenity, or prohibited usage, an administrative appeal may be filed with the Registrar, or a substituted name list may be re-submitted within 5 business days without forfeiting the reservation priority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Submission of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda (filing transmitted electronically by the licensed Bermuda registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Memorandum of Association and Bye-laws in English before a notary or independent witness. The licensed agent then files the Application for Registration of an Exempted Company together with the constitutional documents and simultaneously pays the government incorporation fee of US$1,780. Directors must sign a declaration of qualification confirming fitness for office.
required_dossiers: Application for Registration of an Exempted Company (Form)
Declaration of qualification signed by the first director
Certified true copy of subscriber's passport and proof of residential address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query or requisition, the licensed agent must cure the document deficiency within 10 business days; failure to cure may result in withdrawal of the application, with liberty to re-file under a new application and fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue of Certificate of Incorporation and Charter Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies Registry, Ministry of Finance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfaction of all statutory requirements, the Registrar signs and seals the Certificate of Incorporation. Thereafter, the company's agent certified copies of the Certificate, the Memorandum of Association, and the Bye-laws for use in banking, licensing, and contractual counterparty onboarding.
required_dossiers: Certified true copies of Memorandum of Association and Bye-laws
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate is not issued, the licensed agent reviews the application log and resolves any outstanding payment, signature, or document discrepancy with the Registry's Client Services desk within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office and Registered Agent Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Ministry of Finance (registration effected through the licensed corporate services provider)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The company must maintain a registered office in Bermuda at the physical address of a licensed registered agent (e.g., Walkers, Conyers, Appleby, or an equivalent licensed corporate services provider). The agent files the Notice of Registered Office Address with the Registrar, and the company executes a corporate service provider agreement governing the ongoing statutory representation.
required_dossiers: Registered agent and registered office acceptance letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a registered agent resigns or is disqualified, the company must appoint a new licensed agent and file a fresh notice within 7 days to avoid strike-off proceedings by the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Appointments and Filing of Statutory Notices
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Ministry of Finance (statutory filings); Department of Business & Professional Licensing (business licence filings)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass written resolutions to appoint the president, secretary/treasurer, and any other officers. File the statutory Notice of Directors and Officers with the Registrar within 21 days of appointment, and deliver the beneficial ownership particulars to the registered agent under Bermuda's beneficial ownership framework.
required_dossiers: Form 10 — Notice of Directors and Officers
Consent to act forms for each director and officer
Beneficial ownership declaration under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2018
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late or incomplete filings incur late fees; the licensed agent may submit an application for relief with a written explanation and pay the prescribed penalty to restore the company to full compliance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Business & Professional Licensing, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda, administering the Business Licences Act 1990; the Bermuda Shipping and Maritime Authority (BSMA) is the consultative flag-state authority for marine trade and survey operations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Standard Business Licence — Commercial Services (Marine Surveying and Marine Claims Inspection Support Services for Water Transportation), issued under the Business Licences Act 1990 and Business Licences Regulations 1991.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Government of Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — office-based professional surveying activity not listed under the Environmental (Impact Assessment) Regulations 2019; no Schedule 1 threshold activity is triggered for hull and cargo inspection services.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source industrial discharge is permitted. Vessel-side sampling and survey operations must comply with the Waste Management Regulations and the Environmental Protection (Water Quality) Standards; waste oils, marine pollutants, and contaminated sampling materials must be removed by licensed waste contractors; portable generator and survey equipment noise emissions are limited to daytime commercial port hours.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Bermuda Fire & Rescue Service (BFRS) initial inspection and annual certification for fire safety at the registered office premises; Occupational Health and Safety Act 1999 workplace clearance issued by the Department of Workplace Safety; structural load inspection and electrical safety verification for survey equipment storage areas; port facility access security clearance under the Maritime Security (Port Facilities) Regulations; evidence of professional indemnity insurance required for Business Licence issuance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC) — United Kingdom; Bermuda Registrar of Companies and the Office of the Tax Commissioner for Bermuda corporate tax registration purposes
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Bermuda Exempted Company is formed via the Registrar of Companies and does not receive a domestic VAT or payroll tax identification number unless it registers as an employer under the Bermuda Payroll Tax Act or applies for a Certificate of Compliance. For UK tax purposes, a foreign-incorporated entity with no UK permanent establishment or UK source income is not ordinarily required to register for a UK Corporation Tax, PAYE, or VAT number. If the entity subsequently establishes a UK fixed establishment, the overseas company must register with HMRC for Corporation Tax within six months, and for UK VAT before making taxable supplies above the registration threshold. For Bermuda economic substance reporting, the entity must file annual economic substance declarations with the Registrar of Companies and may need a TIN equivalent for tax information exchange purposes in the jurisdiction of ultimate beneficial ownership.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No federal-style check-the-box election applies in Bermuda. A Bermuda Exempted Company may elect non-resident status under the Companies Act 1981 to be treated as non-resident for exchange control purposes, provided it is controlled and managed outside Bermuda. Election for exemption from Bermuda income tax may be obtained for qualifying exempted undertakings, subject to the International Business Companies (Tax Exemption) Act 2022, while entities with UK tax exposure may make a UK corporation tax election only to the extent a deemed UK permanent establishment arises under the OECD Pillar Two rules or the UK's separate legal entity rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No domestic general indirect tax (no VAT/GST); Bermuda levies payroll tax and customs duties; UK VAT may apply only if UK taxable supplies are made
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Bermuda has no VAT registration threshold. UK VAT registration threshold is GBP 90,000 of taxable turnover for a relevant UK business; Bermuda payroll tax registration applies once an employer payroll exceeds the exemption threshold, presently calculated based on the annual exempt amount for employees earning up to the minimum wage band.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Bermuda imposes no electronic invoicing or fiscal clearance mandate. UK VAT invoicing and Making Tax Digital (MTD) rules apply only if the entity registers for UK VAT, requiring VAT-compliant e-invoices and digital record-keeping via MTD-compatible software with HMRC API submissions. Bermuda customs import declarations use the Customs Automated System for duty assessment, but no real-time fiscal stamping or continuous transaction control clearance exists.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is not applicable in Bermuda because Bermuda imposes no VAT. For UK VAT purposes, the export of goods or the supply of certain offshore services to a recipient outside the UK may be zero-rated under the Value Added Tax Act 1994 Schedule 8, provided the exporter holds evidence of removal from the UK within prescribed time limits and the supply falls within Item 1A of Group 1 (goods) or the reverse charge / belonging rules for services. Marine insurance survey services supplied to a non-UK insurer or an overseas insured in respect of marine cargo may qualify as a zero-rated supply of services if the recipient belongs outside the UK and the service is not treated as supplied where the property is located; services physically performed in Bermuda are not within the UK VAT net unless a UK establishment supplies them.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (UK Single Administrative Document or electronic declaration via the Customs Declaration Service)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / Proof of Physical Export
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank transfer evidence received in the UK or Bermuda
Marine Insurance Survey Report and Underwriting Claim Instruction
Evidence of Permanent Export (port departure stamps, shipping line confirmation, carrier certificates)
Inspection survey invoice and contract with non-UK insurer or foreign insured
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: For UK VAT purposes, incorrect zero-rating claims for exports attract HMRC assessments, penalty rates under Schedule 24 Finance Act 2007 for careless or deliberate inaccuracies, and retrospective clawback of output VAT plus interest. Penalty may be up to 100% of the tax lost for deliberate and concealed conduct. Fraudulent evasion of VAT and false export evidence are criminal offences under the Value Added Tax Act 1994 sections 72 and 167, with imprisonment up to seven years and unlimited fines. In Bermuda, false customs declarations are punishable under the Customs Act 1965 and the Proceeds of Crime Act 1997; any wrongfully claimed exemption from Bermuda economic substance obligations may lead to penalties of BMP 10,000 to BMP 250,000 or designations as a non-compliant entity with potential strike-off.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA), operating under the Bermuda Monetary Authority Act 1969 and the Exchange Control Act 1972, with the Exchange Control Regulations 1998 governing delegated powers
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermudian Dollar (BMD) is pegged at 1:1 to USD. Current account transactions (trade in services, claim inspection fees, operational disbursements) are freely convertible and require no BMA approval. Capital account transactions, including the issue or transfer of shares of an exempted company to non-resident investors and the making of any loan, deposit or guarantee to a non-resident, require either specific exchange control permission or confirmation that a general statutory or published permission applies. The BMA treatment of a non-resident-owned exempted company permits primary accounts to be maintained in freely convertible designated currencies (USD, GBP, EUR, CAD, CHF and JPY). Profit and dividend remittance is unrestricted, subject only to bank-level verification; there is no withholding tax on Bermuda dividends or remittances. Practical hurdle: receiving banks require the BMA exchange control permission reference or legal confirmation of general permission before accepting a share subscription wire into a capital escrow account.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender rule or mandatory conversion ratio applies in Bermuda. Exchange controls were substantially liberalized in 1993, and all export earnings, survey fees and insurance-related service receipts may be retained in the currency of receipt or converted at the licensed bank's quoted rate without time limit. There is no obligation to surrender foreign currency to the BMA or a designated bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Medium as a secondary corridor, Low as a primary banking relationship. Bermuda does not issue standalone e-money institution (EMI) licences; deposit-taking requires a licence under the Banks and Deposit Companies Act 1999. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise Business and Revolut Business are not regulated by the BMA and cannot lawfully open a domestic Bermuda settlement account; however, they remain operationally viable as a supplementary cross-border rail for low-value disbursements to UK and EU subcontractors and for receiving non-regulated payments from Lloyd's underwriters and brokers. Legal constraint: EMIs must never hold the exempted company's statutory share capital or escrowed capital, as they lack regulated custody and cannot issue the BMA-compliant acknowledgements required for exchange control compliance. The treasury structure should therefore maintain a licensed Bermuda bank account for capital and settlement, with an EMI used only as a marginal, non-critical disbursement channel.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors is not strictly mandated, but all licensed banks require a live video interview with each authorized signatory and ultimate beneficial owner, supported by a notarized identification pack. Butterfield and HSBC Bermuda accept remote onboarding for low-risk non-resident corporate clients subject to: (i) a certified passport of each director and beneficial owner, (ii) a notarized certificate of good standing for the corporate parent, (iii) a live compliance video call, and (iv) an independent director's declaration witnessed by a Bermuda-registered barrister or corporate service provider. At least one director with substantive operational authority must hold a recognized professional credential and pass enhanced background screening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial ownership: exempted company owned by a discretionary trust or multi-layered holding structure with nominee shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified register of members and Beneficial Ownership Register filing confirmation under the Companies and Limited Liability Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2018; trust deed or foundation constitutional document; KYC file on settlor, protector and each material beneficiary; independent Bermuda legal opinion confirming the full ownership chain; BMA exchange control permission for the issue of non-resident shares; and a signed statutory declaration from the corporate administrator.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulatory adjacency: marine insurance surveying perceived as an unlicensed financial-sector activity or claims handling without authorization
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business scope certificate evidencing ISIC 5222 and NAICS 488390 classification; confirmation that the entity performs physical condition and damage inspection only and does not take risk, underwrite policies, collect premiums or settle claims as a principal; professional indemnity insurance certificate; membership of the International Institute of Marine Surveying or equivalent; copies of survey contracting terms with underwriters; and an AML/CTF risk self-assessment demonstrating a Low_Risk_Standard rating.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and high-risk jurisdiction exposure: counterparty, cargo, vessel or payee appearing on OFAC/UK HM Treasury/FATF grey-list or with opaque ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full sanctions screening logs for all directors, counterparties and payment beneficiaries; corporate due-diligence questionnaires completed for each material trade counterparty; the vessel IMO number and flag-state registration evidence; cargo ownership declarations; contractual invoices referencing the survey engagement; and a written compliance statement that the company does not accept MTOs or instructions from sanctioned entities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party funding of share capital: injection routed from a group treasury centre rather than from the shareholder's direct bank account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Group treasury structure chart; executed intercompany contribution or loan agreement; audited financial statements of the contributing entity; source of wealth evidence for the ultimate parent (audited accounts and bank statements covering the funding period); CFO statutory declaration confirming the absence of undisclosed third-party interests; and a board resolution of the Bermuda company approving the inward remittance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) Obtain BMA exchange control permission (or written confirmation of an applicable general permission) for the issue of ordinary shares to the non-resident parent; (2) execute subscription agreement and board resolution in advance of any transfer; (3) parent wires funds via SWIFT MT103 to the Bermuda operational/escrow account at Butterfield or HSBC; (4) remittance information field must state 'Share subscription - Bermuda Exempted Company - corporate treasury injection' and reference the BMA permission number; (5) the wiring bank must include the company's full legal name, account number, and purpose code matching a non-export goods/service capital transfer; (6) deliver to the receiving bank the subscriber KYC pack, subscription agreement, and source-of-funds evidence; (7) any inbound aggregate above USD 100,000 requires pre-notification to the bank's AML compliance unit and a 2-3 business day hold for enhanced verification. The use of vague purpose codes such as 'payment for services' or 'consulting' will trigger rejection or a 5-10 business day compliance freeze.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail: SWIFT MT103 for all operational disbursements, including subcontractor survey fees, professional indemnity premiums, office costs, and indemnification payments under marine claims survey protocols. For trade-related settlements, a Commercial Letter of Credit (unconfirmed irrevocable sight LC issued by a London or New York nominee bank) is the designated fallback instrument where the beneficiary requires payment undertaking for larger hull repair disbursements. Rail selection: MT103 is preferred for all values; Wise Business (embedded fintech rail) is permissible for UK/EU disbursements below GBP 10,000 equivalent, provided the beneficiary accepts non-bank settlement; LC is used only when contractually mandated. Every outbound payment must carry MT103 field 70 remittance data referencing the survey contract number, vessel IMO number and invoice number. Submissions are made before the bank's local cut-off window (approximately 1:00 PM Bermuda Atlantic Time) to preserve same-day value dating, and each payment is pre-screened against OFAC, HM Treasury, EU and UN sanctions lists.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Flexible forward currency contracts (FX forwards) in USD/EUR and USD/GBP with a Bermuda licensed bank or via the UK parent treasury, tenor up to 12 months, fully cash-backed
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) solely for BMD notional exposures where physical settlement is impractical; usage is minimal because BMD is fixed at 1:1 to USD
Plain-vanilla cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR and USD/GBP) matched to premium collection cycles and claims reserve funding obligations
Zero-cost collar structures (buy call / sell put) permitted only with prior treasury committee approval and fully collaterized; speculative uncovered positions are expressly prohibited

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda Companies Registry, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary date of incorporation plus 30 days.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of BMD 500; continued default after Registrar notice may trigger restriction of transactions and administrative strike-off under Companies Act 1981 s. 261.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Accountant General, Bermuda Treasury (payable through Registrar of Companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary date of incorporation annually; no statutory grace period, though a 30-day administrative window is commonly accepted.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late payment penalty charged after one month; continued non-payment permits the Registrar to strike the company off without further notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Beneficial Ownership Portal, Government of Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed together with the Annual Return within 30 days after the anniversary; all in-year changes to beneficial ownership must be reported within 15 days.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil penalty of BMD 10,000 and daily fine of BMD 1,000 for non-compliance; knowingly false declarations may incur imprisonment up to two years.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Economic Substance Authority, Ministry of Finance, Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Required for exempted companies forming part of an international group; if a relevant activity applies, file under the relevant activity within six months after financial year-end. Marine surveying (ISIC 5222) is not a designated relevant activity unless conducted as licensed insurance business.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil penalties up to BMD 250,000 and daily fines up to BMD 5,000; repeat non-compliance may result in annulment of certain tax certificates.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is mandatory for a non-licensed private exempted company. Mandatory audit applies if the company is listed, offers securities to the public, is licensed by the Bermuda Monetary Authority (e.g., insurer or insurance manager), or is directed by the Registrar. A pure marine insurance surveyor (ISIC 5222) without BMA licensing is generally audit-exempt.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Bermuda has no local GAAP prescribed for exempted companies; the board may adopt IFRS, IFRS for SMEs, or US GAAP. IFRS is commonly expected for international marine-sector counterparties.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The exempted company must maintain a beneficial ownership register at its registered office and confirm it annually through the Registrar's Beneficial Ownership Portal, simultaneous with the Annual Return. Any individual holding 25% or more of shares, voting rights, or ultimate control is reportable. Transfers occurring during the year must be updated on the register within 15 days; the annual confirmation is a true-and-complete declaration and is due even if no share transfer occurred.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$8,000 – US$15,000 per year if voluntarily audited; not mandatory

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions; the standard exemption produces an effective rate of 0%. In-scope constituent entities of multinational enterprise groups (combined revenue ≥ EUR 750 million) are subject to a 15% corporate income tax under the Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act, 2023, effective for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2025.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda CIT Return (Form CIT-1) filed electronically through the Bermuda Tax Administration's Corporate Income Tax Portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within nine months after the end of the fiscal year (e.g., a 31 December year-end requires filing by 30 September of the following year).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique Bermuda company registration number and CIT tax reference
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident exempted company that is not a constituent entity of an in-scope MNE has no CIT filing obligation; if in-scope, the entity must register with the BTA and obtain a CIT reference number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The accounting period end date to which the return relates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the same fiscal year as the ultimate parent entity of the MNE group for consistency with GloBE reporting.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from vessel hull and cargo damage inspection services, including crew survey fees and any incidental IP income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all revenue attributable to Bermuda; for surveying services performed at sea outside Bermuda, follow the OECD GloBE rules on place of performance and permanent establishment thresholds.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting profit adjusted for GloBE exclusions, substance-based carve-out, and eligible refundable tax credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute under the Bermuda GloBE rules; exclude profit attributable to foreign permanent establishments if properly allocated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 – Qualifying Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of top-up tax under the Income Inclusion Rule or Undertaxed Profits Rule
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a standalone marine surveyor, no top-up tax; for an MNE constituent entity, apply the IIR/UTPR as applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net CIT liability after offsets and credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If no liability, enter BMD 0 and file a nil return; payment due by the same deadline.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed penalty of BMD 25,000 plus BMD 5,000 for each month of delay. Incorrect returns: penalty up to BMD 250,000. Persistent default: strike-off from the Register and criminal prosecution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Annual Return (Form AR-1) filed with the Registrar of Companies via the eReturn system
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before 31 January of the following calendar year, irrespective of the company's financial year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Schedule A – Registered Office and Principal Place of Business
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda physical address and local registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An exempted company must maintain a registered office in Bermuda; it may keep its principal place of business overseas.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal names and addresses of all directors and officers
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: At least two directors are required; one must be an individual. Non-resident directors are permitted without any Bermuda residency test.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Penalty of BMD 100 per day of default, capped at BMD 5,000; continued failure leads to automatic strike-off of the company.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Bermuda does not have any comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAs); it only maintains tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs). Therefore, no DTA relief application, tax residence certificate, or beneficial ownership form is needed for dividend repatriation. A Bermuda exempted company may distribute dividends freely to non-resident shareholders without any withholding, clearance, or reporting to the BTA.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on cross-border royalties and interest; no treaty rate applicable. Interest paid on intercompany loans and licence fees for marine survey software are not subject to any Bermuda tax at source.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Master File required when the MNE group's consolidated revenue exceeds BMD 750 million. Local File required when the Bermuda entity's related-party transactions exceed BMD 1 million in aggregate per fiscal year (or 10% of total revenue if that amount is higher).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Bermuda Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) 2019 impose substance requirements only for entities carrying on 'relevant activities' (banking, insurance, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, shipping, distribution, service centre, and IP). Marine insurance surveying is not a relevant activity; therefore a pure surveyor has no ESR filing obligation. However, if the exempted company also acts as a licensed insurer or holds intangible assets, it must meet the full economic substance test, maintain records, and file an annual ESR declaration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A constituent entity of an in-scope MNE group knowingly fails to file Form CIT-1, omits marine survey revenue, or inflates the substance-based carve-out to reduce the 15% top-up tax to zero.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Additional tax equal to 100% of the evaded CIT; monetary penalty of BMD 250,000; criminal fine on conviction for fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held jointly and severally liable to pay the unpaid tax (CIT Act s.24); intentional evasion attracts imprisonment up to 5 years, confiscation of assets, and a travel ban pending clearance of the tax debt.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the exempted status to route marine survey fees through an entity with no staff, no physical office, and no business purpose, while claiming a per-diem or management fee deduction that drains profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-characterisation as a taxable domestic entity; disallowance of all intra-group deductions; penalty of BMD 50,000 for failure to maintain commercial substance documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false substance declarations face personal fines up to BMD 250,000, disqualification from acting as directors for 10 years, and potential extradition on fraud charges.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting large wire transfers from captive insurer or re-insurance counterparties without customer due diligence, ignoring red flags on marine cargo claims, or failing to file a Suspicious Transaction Report until after the claim is paid.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties up to BMD 1,000,000 per breach; suspension or revocation of the marine survey licence issued under the Insurance Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers may be prosecuted under the Proceeds of Crime Amendment Act 2024; conviction attracts imprisonment up to 10 years, forfeiture of property benefiting from the suspected funds, and personal civil liability for losses.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Bribery and Corruption in Public Procurement
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying kickbacks to a port authority official or a cargo owner's loss adjuster to secure exclusive marine survey contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine equal to twice the benefit obtained; debarment from public contracts for 10 years; forfeiture of survey fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil may be pierced to hold directors liable for restitution; imprisonment for up to 7 years under the Bribery Act (Bermuda) 2024.
